::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 11th 1892  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95[^1]
:::

Dear Mr Palgrave
Thank you much for the little book—I am very glad of the testimony to its popularity.[^2]

I suppose your change was in doubt whether the Bothwell affair was Anteros, as no lover at all; and that on that subject you have changed your mind. I think I incline to the belief that the Casket letters were old ones to Darnley garbled for Elizabeth’s benefit. Have you seen the fragment at Hatfield?

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: We have not identified the book, nor the place in which Palgrave had written about the Casket Letters of Mary Queen of Scots.
